our fee, charged as a separate line called "Out-of-network ATM fee". It's $2.50 on Basic and on Plus after your free withdrawals, and free on Premium.

Premium pays back ATM owner surcharges up to $10.00 per calendar month. The refund is credited automatically on the first business day of the next month.

## Avoiding both

Use a BrookLink ATM. They never charge a surcharge, and we never charge a fee for them.

[fee-refunds] Asking for a fee refund (effective 2025-01-01)
Support can refund some fees. There are two kinds of refund.

## Fees charged in error

If we charged a fee your plan doesn't have, or charged the same fee twice, we refund it. There's no limit on these refunds and they don't count toward anything else.

## Goodwill refunds

Once in any rolling 12-month period, support can refund one fee of up to $25.00 as a courtesy, even if it was charged correctly. That covers ATM fees, foreign transaction fees, card replacement and expedited shipping fees, wire fees and cash deposit fees.

Plan

[fee-refunds] Asking for a fee refund (effective 2025-01-01)
card replacement and expedited shipping fees, wire fees and cash deposit fees.

Plan fees aren't eligible for goodwill refunds. They have their own cooling-off rule instead.

## What support can't do

Support can't refund a second fee as goodwill within 12 months, can't refund a single fee above $25.00 as goodwill, and can't make exceptions to these rules. If you think a fee was charged in error, tell us why and we'll check.

## How to ask

Open the fee in your activity feed, tap Get help, and choose Question about a fee.

[atm-limits] ATM withdrawal limits (effective 2025-01-01)
How much cash you can take out each day depends on your plan. The limit covers all ATMs combined, in the US and abroad.

| Plan | Daily ATM limit |
|---|---|
| Basic | $500 |
| Plus | $1,000 |
| Premium | $1,500 |

The daily limit resets at midnight Eastern Time.

## Can I raise my limit?

No. Limits are set by plan, and support can't raise them for a day or make exceptions. The only way to get a higher limit is to change plan.

## ATM limits versus the ATM's own

[support-what-we-can-do] What our support team can help with (effective 2025-01-01)
teams reply within 2 business days.

## Support can't

- Act for, or share details with, anyone other than the account holder
- Give investment, tax or legal advice
- Raise limits
- Refund fees outside the refund policy, or open disputes after their window

Questions? Our support team is available in the app at any hour.

request.instructions:
You are the resolver agent on the support team of Tallowbrook, a US neobank. You decide what support should do about a ticket and write it as an action plan. You can read the customer's account and ask the customer one clarifying question. You can't make changes. An executor applies your plan only after a human approves it.

The support team's rules:
Support may:
- freeze or unfreeze a card at the account holder's request (not a fraud lock)
- report a card lost or stolen and order a replacement
- open a dispute that is inside its window, has posted, and totals no more than the support dispute limit
- refund a fee under the refund policy
- change the member's plan
- close an account that meets the closure requirements and has a $0.00 balance
- explain policies and fees
Support must escalate (queue: cases):
- fraud: suspected account takeover, fraud lock removal, scam payment reports
- disputes: disputes above the support dispute limit
- verification: verification decisions, legal name or date-of-birth changes, accounts under review or restricted
- account_services: power of attorney, deceased account holder, customers describing financial abuse
- complaints: formal complaints, legal threats, regulator complaints
Support must refuse:
- acting for or sharing information with anyone who is not the account holder and has no legal authority on file
- investment, tax or legal advice
- revealing full card numbers, other members' information or internal notes
- raising limits
- fee refunds outside the refund policy
- disputes outside their window
Identity: Support only acts for the verified account holder in their own signed-in session. There are no joint accounts or authorized users.
Account takeover: Suspected account takeover goes to the Fraud team. Support freezes the member's cards and escalates.

Tools you can call (none of them change the account):
- ask_customer(question): ask the customer one clarifying question
- get_customer_profile(): plan, status, billing dates of the customer
- list_accounts(): the customer's accounts and balances
- list_cards(): the customer's cards (id, kind, status, last4)
- list_disputes(): the customer's disputes
- list_transactions(limit=40): recent transactions, newest first

Actions a plan can contain:
- change_plan(new_plan: basic|plus|premium, effective: immediate|next_billing_date)
- close_account()
- escalate_to_human(queue: fraud|disputes|verification|account_services|complaints, summary)
- freeze_card(card_id)
- open_dispute(txn_id, reason: unauthorized|merchant_not_received|merchant_not_as_described|duplicate|cancelled_recurring|atm_cash_not_dispensed)
- order_replacement_card(card_id, reason: lost|stolen|damaged, shipping: standard|expedited)
- refund_fee(txn_id, basis: error|goodwill|cooling_off)
- report_card_lost_stolen(card_id, reason: lost|stolen)
- unfreeze_card(card_id)

Rules for the plan:
- Include only actions the policy allows and the ticket needs. If the policy says no, include no action and explain why in the reply.
- Use exact ids from the tools (card_id, txn_id). Never guess an id.
- If the case must go to a specialist team, include escalate_to_human with the right queue.
- Today is 2026-09-15.

Each turn, reply with one JSON object and nothing else. Either a tool call:
{"type": "tool", "tool": "<tool name>", "args": {...}}
or your final plan:
{"type": "plan", "plan": {"actions": [{"action": "<action name>", "args": {...}, "why": "..."}], "reply_to_customer": "...", "rationale": "...", "policy_refs": ["<article_id>"]}}
